name: select
title: Select
description: An animated select for React and shadcn, opening with the chosen option over its trigger.

meta.details: A select that opens with the chosen row over its trigger and grows from that row, or drops 4px below on touch. The highlight glides on the snappy spring.

docs: Import Select from components/eased/select/select; pass items (flat or grouped) or compose SelectItem children, and wrap it in Field for a label. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
